h: Remembering Hashem Amid Failure Opens the Way to Repair

p: "Even when I walk in the valley of the shadow of death,
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמַר (בְּרָכוֹת סג, א)
and He will straighten your paths":
even for a matter of transgression";
and the reading of the Ein Yaakov:
the thief at the mouth of the tunnel
although he commits an explicit transgression,
כֵּיוָן שֶׁאֵינוֹ שׁוֹכֵחַ אֶת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
since he does not forget Hashem Yisbarach
and believes in Hashem at the time of the act,
for he calls on the Merciful One
that Hashem Yisbarach will straighten his paths,
"and none will be cast away from Him,"
and he will have a rectification.
the yetzer hara makes one forget everything,
that at the moment of the yetzer hara
no one remembers the yetzer tov.
Not so when he remembers Hashem,
only it is hidden from him
and he thought he was doing good;
from the commentary of the Rambam, of blessed memory,
with the yetzer tov and the yetzer hara," etc.:
"and even at the time of transgression
for all this is the yetzer hara,
and even in a matter of transgression."
It is implied that he explains
at the time of a transgression,
similar to the reading of the Ein Yaakov,
And this is the matter in this parashah:
that they brought wrath, as it were,
אֲבָל כְּתִיב בְּפָרָשָׁה זוֹ ב׳ פְּעָמִים
But in this parashah it is written twice,
מַמְרִים הֱיִיתֶם עִם ה׳ (דְּבָרִים ט, ז; ט, כד)
that this he did not say as a fault;
Hashem your God in the wilderness;
that you went out of the land of Egypt," etc.
like a fetus in its mother's womb.
they merited that although they committed sins,
was not entirely forgotten by them,
even at the time of the transgression,
along the lines of what it says,
even for a matter of transgression.
וְכֵן אָמַר אַחַר כָּךְ (שָׁם ט, כד)
from the day I knew you":
and he was the root of the aspect of Daas,
and he instilled in them too
and therefore the generation of the wilderness is called
and this is the meaning of
that even when you were rebellious,
for Hashem was not forgotten by them.
"Here we are, and we will go up";
שֶׁהֲרֵי מֹשֶׁה אָמַר לָהֶם (שָׁם יד, מב)
for Hashem is not in your midst," etc.
that since they were doing teshuvah
Hashem Yisbarach would be appeased toward them
And this is what it says,
So too Dovid HaMelech, alav hashalom,
at the time that he did
it did not occur to him at all
רְאוּיָה הָיְתָה בַּת שֶׁבַע לְדָוִד וְכוּלֵּי
"Bas Sheva was fit for Dovid," etc.,
and Hashem Yisbarach revealed to him
that the test would be in this matter,
it did not occur to him
when he heard from the prophet (Shmuel II 12:7),
and knew that it was a sin,
that at the time of the sin too
and he was confident that it would be
And even after it was told to him,
he said, "Your rod and Your staff,
that he would afterward merit a staff;
